text_block_list.text: On the first day of the new year, I went on a Hatsumode shrine visit at Rice Shower's invitation.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother. Rice decided
on one wish to make.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Onee-sama. Rice has
decided on one wish."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, would you mind hearing me out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because this is a wish
I have to ask of you, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because this is a wish
I have to ask of you, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice wants to run in the Tenno Sho (Spring) next.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Because I want to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)... is the stage every stayer
dreams of... right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I figured a lot of strong Umamusume
would gather here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Rice—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have to keep moving forward.
I can't... go around saying I'm scared."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...For Bourbon-san's sake, too.
choice_data_list: You're fully prepared for it, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Up until now, I always wanted
to be a blue rose that brings happiness, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I realized that just thinking about it isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So as not to... make the person in front of me sad,
I felt like I had to take action first...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Someday, Rice has to run the greatest race in history...
as a 'rival.'"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... even if it seems impossible,
I want to become someone who can make "miracles" happen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Onii-sama!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Onee-sama!!

"If we're aiming for the Tenno Sho (Spring)...
it would be wise to get her legs accustomed to distance in a longer race beforehand."

First up is the spring Nikkei Sho.
What we should aim for in that 2500m turf race is—
choice_data_list: Let's definitely finish within the top 3 in the Nikkei Sho!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Big Sister!
Rice Shower has set a new goal for herself starting with the new year.

To make the most of that momentum,
I decided to write my New Year's resolution on an Ema plaque.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Dear God,
Rice will do her best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'm so glad
I could come with you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'm so glad
I could come with you, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's your turn next, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's your turn next, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will make a wish together with you.
"Please, God, grant our wish..."
choice_data_list: I hope everyone gets well soon.
I want to keep supporting Rice's running

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's right. I hope Bourbon-san's
injuries heal up quickly too."
choice_data_list: I hope you stay healthy too, Rice

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, yes.
I have to be careful... so I don't make you worry.

"And after fueling up at the New Year's shrine stalls,
we began our training."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If you say something that sweet,
I won't know what to do with myself...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... But I don't have time to cry.
Rice has to... do her best, and yet...

"...After taking some time to soothe Rice Shower,
we started our training."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-Strength...?
Umm... Well...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Rice can help with anything?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, like strength training or match races...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Still, really, if there's anything Rice can do to help...
just say the word, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it's for you, Onii-sama... Rice will help
with anything at all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If it's for you, Onee-sama... Rice will help
with anything at all...

"...Feeling touched by Rice Shower's thoughtfulness,
I headed back to the academy."
